commit.message:
Apply approved Stage 9 files and preserve blocking receipt audit

Install the exact 11 additions from 06b40caa6bf5. Record file-only approval, safe checks, three receipt integrity gaps, and the dedicated-runner plan. No signing, workflow dispatch, registration or deployment. Stage 9 remains CURRENT; end_to_end=false.

Adopt approved Stage 9 contract and propose exact provenance implementation

Apply only the three approved contract additions at 097431cf. Preserve the approval record and failed preparation checks. Freeze eleven unapplied gate, workflow and EXIT-harness additions for separate review. All Stage 9 EXITs remain NOT RUN; end_to_end=false.

Propose Stage 9 provenance trust contract for exact approval

Freeze three proposed protected additions for signer identity, proof-to-artifact policy, and deployed-file observation. Preserve Stage 7–8 records and all protected files. Record proposal checks only; all six Stage 9 EXIT commands remain NOT RUN.

Complete Stage 8 verified refund boundary and evidence replay

Apply the exact approved prototype-preserving snapshot repair. All three real EXIT commands pass, including source-proof, effect-bypass, duplicate-dispatch, mutation and evidence-method rejection controls. Preserve all failed attempts, raw logs, identities, seeds and canonical evidence.

The exact repaired assertion accepts four unchanged prototype combinations and rejects 16 real field/prototype mutations. Source and property evidence each reproduce through three fresh accepted runs. Model quality remains unmeasured; end_to_end=false.

Mark Stage 8 DONE and Stage 9 CURRENT. No Stage 9 implementation is included.

Record Stage 8 source-proof success and frozen integration-test blocker

Adopt the exact approved gate additions. Implement the unprotected refund adapter and EXIT harness. Preserve all real attempts: wrapper-proof 1 then 0; hostile-outputs 1; evidence-separation 1. Archive source rejection controls, seeded failures, raw outputs and byte-identical source replay.

Keep the approved gate unchanged. Document its null-prototype snapshot defect and an unapplied diagnostic repair. Stage 8 remains CURRENT; Stage 9 has not started; end_to_end=false.

Adopt approved Stage 8 refund contract; propose exact verification gate

Apply the four approved contract additions unchanged. Preserve real development proof, audit, build and static-check records, including the failed type check. Publish a separate three-file gate proposal for exact approval. All Stage 8 EXITs remain NOT RUN; end_to_end=false.

Propose Stage 8 refund boundary contract for exact human approval

Require universal safety and exact acceptance of every eligible proposal, with Rejected and an empty refund plan for fallback. Publish four unapplied protected-file additions, numeric/reason/wire/lifecycle decisions, scope limits and evidence requirements.

Dafny resolution, patch dry-run and policy schema validation returned 0; none is a proof. Keep Stage 8 CURRENT with all EXITs NOT RUN and end_to_end=false. No protected files or refund implementation changed.

Complete Stage 7 with an independently checked proof of Forge's C ELF

Prove normal exit 0 for every valid modeled execution of the pinned 1,240-byte RISC-V self-test. Add and check a valid-entry witness, bind both exact propositions with the published wrapper, and independently check all 579 dependency modules. Preserve the 13 theorem-specific and 86 closure assumptions, source and ELF identities, exact commands, and historical failures.

All three Stage 7 EXITs returned 0. Publish the exact ELF, canonical evidence, and lossless indexed record archive. Mark Stage 7 DONE and Stage 8 CURRENT, with Stage 8 implementation and performance experiments deferred. Keep end_to_end=false; compiler correctness, model fidelity and deployment identity are not established.

Recover Stage 7 and verify the upstream binary-proof boundary

Use a writable case-sensitive Linux checkout under the intended non-root user. Preserve the case-collision, permission, and wrapper failures.

Record a successful pinned zlib replay with both independent Rocq checks and assumption audits. Reject the prepared invalid proof and a valid True certificate at the published theorem-binding wrapper. Retain complete raw records in a verified tar/xz archive.

Stage 7 remains CURRENT. Forge's own binary proof and performance study are pending; end_to_end=false.

Complete Stage 6 booking proofs and measured proof reuse

Add the approved booking contract, checked matcher and retry/cancellation trace, source evidence gate, and rejection controls. Publish all 75 benchmark pairs, retained failures, scoped token accounting, and byte-identical evidence/report replay. Record both real EXIT codes as 0 and advance the roadmap to Stage 7 without starting it.

Propose the Stage 6 booking contract and reuse measurement protocol

Publish the exact pending spec and lock additions, actual resolver and patch-validation results, and append-only uncertainty findings. Keep Stage 6 current with both EXIT commands unrun pending intent approval.

Complete Stage 5 spec tooling with checked witness and mutation evidence

Publish generated claim documentation, finite model comparisons, vacuity diagnostics, mutation results, and preserved command logs. Record both EXIT commands and byte-identical replay; advance the roadmap to Stage 6 without starting it.
Complete Stage 4 with real approved-spec results and set Stage 5 current
Run all Stage 4 exit checks against the approved fee PR and tamper rejection

Merge approved fee spec and verified ledger change

Implement the approved ledger fee with exact spec-bound evidence
